questions.cardText:
[Psychology] Cognitive dissonance is the feeling of discomfort caused by:
A. Holding two contradictory beliefs
B. The tension between consciousness and unconsciousness
C. The conflicts between rational thoughts and emotional feelings
Answer: A.
questions.de: Wie heißt in der Psychologie das Gefühl des Unbehagens, das entsteht, wenn man zwei widersprüchliche Überzeugungen zugleich hegt?
questions.en: What is the name in psychology for the feeling of discomfort caused by holding two contradictory beliefs?

timeline.labelEn: Leon Festinger publishes A Theory of Cognitive Dissonance
timeline.labelDe: Leon Festinger veröffentlicht „A Theory of Cognitive Dissonance“

questions.notes: Card's answer A confirmed: Wikipedia defines it as holding conflicting cognitions, surfacing as psychological discomfort.

questions.cardText:
[Religious Studies] Which of the following is a sacred site in Jerusalem significant to Judaism, Christianity, as well as Islam?
A. Goharshad
B. Dome of the Rock
C. Church of the Holy Sepulchre
Answer: B. The Dome of the Rock is an Islamic shrine. It is sacred to all three religions because it is believed to be the site where Abraham prepared to sacrifice his son Isaac and where Muhammad ascended to heaven.
questions.de: Welches islamische Heiligtum in Jerusalem steht über dem Felsen, an dem Abraham seinen Sohn opfern wollte und von dem aus Mohammed in den Himmel aufgestiegen sein soll?
questions.en: Which Islamic shrine in Jerusalem stands over the rock where Abraham is believed to have prepared to sacrifice his son and from which Muhammad is believed to have ascended to heaven?

timeline.labelEn: The Dome of the Rock is built on Jerusalem's Temple Mount under Caliph Abd al-Malik
timeline.labelDe: Der Felsendom wird unter Kalif Abd al-Malik auf dem Jerusalemer Tempelberg errichtet

questions.notes: Confirmed: built 691–692 over the Foundation Stone; Jews and Christians hold it the site of the binding of Isaac (and the Temple), Muslims the start of Muhammad's Night Journey. Strictly it is the rock/Temple Mount site that is sacred to all three, the building itself is an Islamic shrine. Goharshad is a mosque in Mashhad, Iran.
